prompts.image2d: Use case: style-transfer. Create a TWO-DIMENSIONAL HAND-DRAWN character turnaround from image 1, not a CG image or filtered photograph. Image 1 is authoritative for this exact character's identity, face, mature age direction, proportions, pose, costume, colors, accessories, limb count and all three view details. Image 2 is ONLY a drawing-style reference: refined controlled dark ink linework, subtle line weight, restrained cel color blocks, soft illustrated volume and fine faint paper texture. Do not copy bull identity horns or clothes from image 2. Preserve the original species and existing degree of anthropomorphism, not a redesign. Landscape 3:2 sheet: left full front, center full side, right full back, same scale and baseline, ample margins including full antennae/antlers/wing tips/feet. Warm pale beige paper backdrop with subtle drawn contact shadow. Crisp detailed line-art drawn fur/feathers and fabric folds, clearly non-photoreal and non-3D. No labels text watermark panels scenery extra people. Hen cleaner. Keep tawny cream layered feathers, red comb and wattles, teal-gray work clothes, beige apron with spray bottle cloth and brush, yellow gloves, dark shoes, hen tail.
prompts.image3d: Use case: stylized-concept. AstralPact animal-world character design. Create ONE landscape 3:2 character turnaround sheet of the SAME character: left front view, center side view, right back view, equal scale, aligned feet, complete head feet tail and wings with generous space. Plain warm light gray beige studio backdrop, natural contact shadow. Image 1 is ONLY rendering quality reference: high-end feature-film 3D CGI, physically based materials, crisp natural detail, soft key and subtle cool fill; do NOT copy dragon identity, horns, jewelry or royal clothes. Image 2 ONLY reference for series anthropomorphic working-person proportions, practical worn clothing and three-view presentation; do NOT copy pigeon species, helmet or courier backpack. Mature dignified everyday worker, expressive animal face, not baby/chibi, not caricature of stupidity or misery. Fine individual fur/feathers where appropriate, woven cloth, believable seams and restrained material highlights. All three angles consistent anatomy clothing accessories. No text, labels, logos, watermark, scenery, extra characters. Adult female anthropomorphic hen, warm tawny and cream feathers, modest red comb and wattles, short sturdy beak, kind alert brown eyes. Upright natural worker build. Dusty teal housekeeping tunic and trousers, beige utility apron, rolled sleeves, yellow rubber work gloves on wing-derived articulated hands, non-slip dark work shoes adapted to bird feet, small cleaning cloth and spray bottle secured in apron pockets. Small hen tail visible consistently. Indoor cleaner identity, practical modest clean well-used clothing, neutral attentive expression.
